worker: ntaining a comma, double quote, CR or LF is quoted, with inner quotes doubled. Other fields, such as `Zoë Van Dyke`, stay plain.

The code is a small private `field` helper plus the exported function, written in the style of `json.js`.

The tests assert on exact output strings. They cover the BOM and header, the final CRLF, the empty list, the three missing-value positions, input order and each of the four quoting triggers. They also check that a plain field is unquoted and that no bare LF appears as a line terminator.

Git printed a warning that LF will be replaced by CRLF in the two new files the next time it touches them. I did not add a `.gitattributes` or change any line-ending setting.
